news.summary: El Departamento de Estado estadounidense ha instado este lunes a las autoridades de Rusia a compartir información "de forma rápida y transparente" sobre el caso de presunta peste pulmonar en la región de Irkutsk, tras la muerte de una investigadora en un presunto accidente de laboratorio en Shelejov.

news.title: Mueren cinco personas y otras 50 resultan heridas en ataques aéreos rusos sobre la provincia de Járkov
news.summary: Las autoridades ucranianas han informado este lunes de la muerte de al menos cinco personas, además de otras 50 que han resultado heridas, como consecuencia de nuevos bombardeos de las Fuerzas Armadas de Rusia sobre la provincia de Járkov, una de las pocas del este del país que todavía continúa bajo administración de Kiev.

news.title: Sulaf and Late Again on uprooting and reconnecting with their heritage
news.summary: This week, Marjorie Hache has the pleasure of sitting down with Sudan's Sulaf, who is releasing her debut album "Aba", a poetic exploration of traditional Sudanese music with a contemporary twist and which she recorded in Paris where she has been living in exile since 2022.

news.title: US pulls bombers from UK base: Is Iran manoeuvring Trump’s war plans?
news.summary: The withdrawal means the US lost a convenient launchpad, not its underlying strike capability, said an expert.

news.title: Nobel medicine prize honours US and German scientists for optogenetics work
news.summary: The winners of the Nobel Prizes in physics, chemistry, literature, peace and ‌economics will be announced in the week.

news.title: Macron slams Russia’s ‘irresponsible’ strikes on Ukraine’s civilian infrastructure
news.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Monday slammed Russia's increased strikes on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure. In a phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Macron said he reviewed "the concrete support" Europe can provide Ukraine to defend itself against the attacks.

news.title: Iran poised to exploit security vacuum as US leaves Iraq
news.summary: The end of the US military mission in Iraq leaves the Kurdistan region facing a severe security vacuum. As Erbil grapples with deep internal divisions, Tehran is well positioned to make strategic gains.

news.title: A Russian report says a worker at a Siberian plague research institute fell ill and died of an unknown cause
news.summary: Although unconfirmed reports suggest pneumonic plague, officials have not publicly identified the infection.

news.title: What China's new military foothold in Laos means for Southeast Asia
news.summary: Beijing says its new Laos facility will train pilots. Analysts see a broader signal: China's growing military presence in mainland Southeast Asia.

news.title: Spain: 'Mini-hurricane' kills at least two people in Catalonia
news.summary: Two people have ⁠died and ​another is missing after heavy rains and flooding in Spain's ​Catalonia region, authorities said on Sunday.

news.title: Samoa prime minister apologises after Nazi salute video surfaces
news.summary: Samoa PM has apologised after a video of him resurfaced, showing him leading a Nazi salute and saying ‘Heil Hitler'.

news.title: De 1,3 milhão a 5 mil votos: como cearenses derrubaram Tiririca após 14 anos eleito por SP
news.summary: Humorista, que foi o deputado mais votado do país em 2010, perdeu sua primeira eleição justamente na estreia como candidato pelo Estado onde nasceu.

news.title: Os gráficos que explicam como Flávio Bolsonaro chegou à frente de Lula no 1º turno
news.summary: BBC News Brasil selecionou mapas e gráficos que ajudam a entender o resultado das urnas e o cenário previsto para o 2º turno.

news.title: 'Lula terá que fazer gesto expressivo para virar a situação', diz analista político
news.summary: Em entrevista na BBC News Brasil, o analista político Creomar de Souza destacou o que considera um erro da campanha de Lula: a falta de diálogo com o centro.

news.title: Is Iran charging a toll to allow oil traffic through Hormuz?
news.summary: Crude exports bypassing Hormuz surged in September, yet oil prices remain high. Could a secret fee be the reason?

news.title: Trump heads to Nebraska as Republicans fear strongholds could flip
news.summary: US President ​Donald Trump will visit Nebraska on Monday to rally Republicans and promote his economic ​record, taking his message of new investment and manufacturing to a state where farmers and truckers face sharply higher diesel prices and voters worry about inflation. His stop in ​the ‌city of Grand Island is part of Trump's 32-day ⁠sprint to the November 3 midterm elections, a campaign in which he is spending considerable time in ‌Republican strongholds. Trump has urged Republicans to “pretend” he is on the ballot, ⁠arguing that voters should view the midterms as a referendum on his administration and economic record. France 24's Fraser Jackson has more.

news.title: France high school protests: Can the government regain control?
news.summary: Up to 500 schools are expected to be totally or partially closed in France as student protests continue to rock the country. The demonstrations, which have been going on for over two weeks, have spread nationwide and are set to continue and the unrest appears to have caught the Macron government off guard. The protests have confronted French security forces with a daunting task, and the situation is likely to feature at this week's cabinet meeting, where the interior and justice minister will warn that there are few police resources to deploy.

news.title: Japan bids farewell to Asian Games after fortnight of turmoil and records
news.summary: The 20th Asian Games closed on Sunday after a rocky fortnight lit ​up by youthful brilliance in the sporting arenas but tempered by logistical dysfunction and subdued public interest. Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) President Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani declared the Games closed at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, with the torch handed to organisers of the next event in Doha 2030.

news.title: US bombers leave UK air base amid 'new threats': What we know so far
news.summary: The United States confirmed that it had withdrawn all B-1 bombers from the British airbase of RAF Fairford, reportedly due to "new threats," with Britain's government insisting Monday the site is safe. France 24's Philip Turle takes a look at what we know so far.

news.title: Bombs preventing rescue of kidnapped youths, Nigerian police say
news.summary: The father of one of the 19 young abductees tells the BBC he hasn't eaten in three days out of worry.

news.title: La Inteligencia de Alemania acusa a Rusia de una "guerra en la sombra" y apunta a "éxitos" frente a Moscú
news.summary: La Inteligencia de Alemania ha lamentado este lunes que Rusia ya haya "emprendido una guerra en la sombra" con Rusia y ha alertado de que la amenaza contra el país sigue creciendo, al tiempo que ha reivindicado una "mayor resiliencia" frente a Moscú.

news.title: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
news.summary: The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches more than 700 miles and has barely moved in four years. Yet straddling this line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology.

news.title: Georgia officials hunt for suspect in shooting that killed two and injured 35

news.summary: Al menos dos personas han muerto este lunes a causa de un incendio registrado en un buque comercial en aguas del mar Negro frente a las costas de Rumanía, según han confirmado las autoridades del país europeo, que han señalado que otras once personas han sido rescatadas con vida.

news.title: Un guardia fronterizo moldavo herido por un proyectil ruso en un ataque en un paso con Ucrania

news.summary: Estudo mostra que salário baixo é uma das barreiras para atrair e reter docentes; Neste Dia Mundial dos Professores, agência quer ações renovadas para apoiar 107 mil professores pelo globo.

news.title: El Niño intensifica riscos climáticos no sudoeste do Oceano Índico
news.summary: Secas ao sul e enchentes ao norte são esperadas entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2027, com possibilidade de recordes de calor e graves impactos na saúde, agricultura e infraestrutura; Moçambique participou de Fórum sobre o tema.

news.title: ONU libera US$ 160 milhões para conter crises humanitárias negligenciadas
news.summary: Verba vem de fundo emergencial e alcança milhões de pessoas em situação de extrema vulnerabilidade em regiões como África, Ásia, América Latina e Oriente Médio.

news.summary: Enquanto milhões passam fome, um quinto de tudo o que chega ao prato vai para o lixo; prejuízo de US$ 400 bilhões destrói recursos e acelera crise climática; para virar esse jogo, agências FAO e Aiea unem forças na iniciativa Atoms4Food.

news.title: Suspected pneumonic plague in Siberia: What we know about the disease
news.summary: A worker at a plague research institute in Siberia has died, and nearly 200 of her contacts are under medical observation. Russian authorities deny a link to the bacterial infection. The US is monitoring the situation.

news.title: FBI arrests a woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader's family for China
news.summary: The FBI and U.S. prosecutors say Wanying Zhang, also know as Heather, surveilled the Taiwanese president's son and his family.

news.title: Imran Khan supporters march in Pakistan to demand his release after talks failed
news.summary: Talks between Khan's party and the government failed two days ago. Besides Khan's release, protesters demand his transfer to a hospital and family visits.

news.title: Perda de votos no Nordeste e outros obstáculos de Lula para tentar virada inédita no 2º turno
news.summary: Desde redemocratização, em 1988, nunca houve virada entre primeiro e segundo turno da eleição presidencial; entre os desafios, está o de reverter abstenção entre eleitores mais pobres.

news.title: Nobel Prize awarded for revealing inner workings of the brain
news.summary: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.

news.summary: The ongoing investigation has found the attacker intended to crash the plane into Israel's Ben Gurion International Airport, a person familiar with the matter but not authorized to speak publicly told NPR.

news.title: Trump chooses top spy boss to run new AI taskforce
